verdict.rationale: Greptile documents custom rules that catch team-specific issues, configurable via greptile.json, and applies them in automated reviews of every pull request. That covers the core idea of team-defined checks running on every PR. The evidence does not show these rules are written in plain language, nor that they work as discrete pass/fail pre-merge checks (e.g., 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths') rather than review comments. Missing for 10: explicit plain-language rule authoring, per-check pass/fail status or merge gating, examples of checks like docs/test coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I define custom agentic pre-merge checks in plain language — 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths' — that run on every PR
